caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with a light brown finish. The desk features three drawers at the bottom, each with two round wooden knobs as handles. Above the drawers, there is a compartmentalized hutch with multiple rectangular and square cubbyholes of various sizes for organizing items, paperwork, or stationery. The hutch is open and reveals the interior storage spaces. A slanted writing surface or desk lid, covered in dark green material, is attached below the hutch and is open and resting horizontally, extending outwards to provide a workspace. The construction of the desk includes slightly curved feet and simple, functional design lines. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or objects.
title: Desk
